description:
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}.
Arcane Bombardment triggers, exiling an instant or sorcery at random from your graveyard, and casting a copy of Temporal Manipulation without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning Whim of Volrath to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
